# Heading, Text, Link

The type scale and the accent link. Two weights only, 400 and 600. Links show the same 3px ring on keyboard focus as every other control.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/heading-text-link)

## Usage

```tsx
<Heading level={2}>Delivery</Heading>
<Text tone="subdued">Add your shipping address to see the shipping options.</Text>
<Link href="/account/login">Sign in</Link>
<Link onClick={openPolicy}>Refund policy</Link>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `Heading level` | `2 \| 3 \| 4` | 20px section title, 16px sub-section, 14px detail label. |
| `Text tone` | `'default' \| 'subdued'` | Subdued is the grey used for helper text. |
| `Text size` | `'body' \| 'small'` | 14px or 12px. |
| `Link href` | `string` | With it, an anchor. Without it, a button that looks the same. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `Text.module.css`
- `Text.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
